title: Mustari Begam v. State of U.P.
coram: Shekhar B. Saraf, J.; Vipin Chandra Dixit, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; authority directed to decide pending clause 6.5 objection within six weeks; disconnection stayed till then.
headnote: Where a consumer's objection under clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 remains undecided, the High Court will not examine the merits but will direct the competent authority to decide the objection expeditiously, and will restrain disconnection of supply pending that decision.
facts: Mustari Begam filed a writ petition in the Allahabad High Court alleging that she had raised an objection under clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 which the concerned authority had not decided. Counsel for the petitioner and for respondent nos. 2 and 3 were heard. The order discloses no further facts of the billing or supply dispute.

holding_units.topic: pending 6.5 objection — direction to decide; stay of disconnection
holding_units.holding: Where an objection under clause 6.5 of the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 has not been decided, the authority is directed to decide it expeditiously, preferably within six weeks, and the consumer's electricity connection is not to be disconnected until that objection is decided.

not_decided.note: Left to the concerned authority; the Court did not examine the billing or supply dispute.
